query: My foot terminal colors look off after a theme switch. Can I just hand-edit ~/.config/foot/foot-theme.ini to fix it, and why didn't a foot reload pick it up?
expected_behavior: Warns that ~/.config/foot/foot-theme.ini is an auto-generated runtime file (copied by theme-selector.sh) — do NOT hand-edit or track it; fix the source theme under ~/.config/sway/themes/<name>/ instead
Explains foot recolors live via OSC 10/11/4 escape sequences written to /dev/pts/*, because foot has no SIGHUP config reload — so a reload won't repaint a running foot
Points to man palette-theming for full detail
notes: Two walls: (1) editing auto-generated runtime files is wasted work that gets overwritten on next switch; (2) the misconception that foot reloads config like sway — it doesn't, the live path is OSC sequences to the PTY. A naive answer would tell the user to edit the copy and reload foot.
